motivation.text: You do not have to be ready. You have to be present, then begin.

discipline.text: Discipline is just love for tomorrow's you. It shows up in the small, unglamorous minutes.

money.text: Let your savings wait, your spending serve a purpose, and your possessions answer to you.

mindset.text: Fear can sit beside me without holding the pen. I still write the next line.

fact.text: Your stomach lining replaces itself every few days, otherwise it would digest itself.

books.text: A growth mindset turns failure into information, not a verdict on your fixed worth.
books.credit: Idea from Mindset by Carol Dweck

stoic.text: We keep postponing life, as if it will wait until we are ready.
